summary: Post-Nvidia, and the market could not agree with itself. The Nasdaq ran to 27,609 overnight on the Nvidia relief, faded, and closed near 27,191 (up about 0.4%), just enough to reclaim its trailing trend stop. The S&P did not follow, closing near 7,340 (down about 0.3%) and undercutting yesterday's flush low. The real move was in commodities: gold fell 3.2% and crude fell 3.4% in a cash-raising flush, while the VIX eased to 24.4. A mixed tape up top, one-sided only in metals and oil.

event.name: Nvidia earnings reaction and October FOMC minutes
event.consensus: Nvidia was the binary the AI trade hedged into; the minutes were expected to add color on the December decision
event.actual: Nvidia reported Tuesday after the close and the relief pop faded through today's cash session; October FOMC minutes released today at 2:00 PM ET.
event.surprise: The post-Nvidia relief failed to hold and equities went two-sided while gold and crude were liquidated about 3%.
event.nqReaction: NQ ran to a 27,609 overnight high on the Nvidia pop, faded through the cash session, and closed near 27,191 (up about 0.4%), reclaiming its hourly trend stop.
event.crossAsset: ES stayed below its stop and closed red; gold fell 3.2% and crude fell 3.4% in a cash-raising flush; VIX eased to 24.4.

risk.sizing: Volatility is still high even as it eases (VIX 24.4, NQ hourly range over 400 points). The same dollar of risk buys a smaller position, so size down and give stops room behind the wider ATR.
risk.openRisk: The tape is two-sided. The bigger danger is getting chopped by forcing trades in the middle of the range. Let price come to a level.
risk.note: Week ahead: the two scheduled catalysts (Nvidia Tuesday night, October FOMC minutes today) are behind us; nothing of that size is scheduled for Thursday.

psychology: One board turned green today and three stayed red. The easy mistake after a big event is to grab the first strong move and assume the rest will follow. The Nasdaq reclaimed its trend line while the S&P, gold, and crude did not. When your instruments disagree, that is the market telling you it is still unsure. Trade smaller until they line up.
